detail.longDescription:
Phone Cleaner combines useful file-cleaning tools with an Android home screen launcher, giving you quick access to everyday phone features from one place.

You can use supported cleaning tools to review unnecessary files and, if you choose, set Phone Cleaner as your default Home app to use its home screen and app drawer.

🧹 CLEAN UP YOUR PHONE

• Find supported junk and temporary files
• Review removable APK files
• Manage supported files from one place
• Access App Manager and additional cleaning tools
• Review files before removing them

Available cleaning features may vary depending on your Android version, device, and granted permissions.

🏠 YOUR HOME SCREEN

Phone Cleaner can also work as an Android home screen launcher.

If you choose to set Phone Cleaner as your default Home app, it replaces your current home screen and app drawer with the Phone Cleaner home experience.

Features include:

• Quick access to installed apps
• Built-in web search
• News and content feed
• Weather information
• Shortcuts to cleaning tools
• Simple and responsive navigation

Setting Phone Cleaner as your default Home app is optional. You can change your default Home app at any time through Android Settings.

🔎 HOME SCREEN SEARCH

When Phone Cleaner is used as your default Home app, the search box on the Phone Cleaner home screen provides web search powered by Google.

Using Phone Cleaner as your default Home app requires your confirmation during setup.

⚡ SIMPLE SETUP

During setup, you can choose whether to use Phone Cleaner as your default Home app.

You remain in control of the permissions and features you enable, and supported permissions can be changed later through Android Settings.

PERMISSIONS

Some features may require optional permissions:

• Location may be used to provide local weather information.
• Notifications may be used for optional app information, weather information, and supported shortcuts.
• App information may be accessed when using supported App Manager features.

Permissions can be managed through Android Settings. Availability of individual features may depend on your device and Android version.

Download Phone Cleaner to access cleaning tools and an optional home screen experience in one app.
